# The email rule's contract, shared by all THREE implementations of it:
#
#   packaging/installer.iss          LooksLikeEmail   (uninstall survey, Pascal Script)
#   src/bin/app/feedback.rs          looks_like_email (in-app Send feedback box, Rust)
#   packaging/analytics/worker.js    looksLikeEmail   (server-side intake gate, JS)
#
# Three runtimes means three implementations; this file is what stops them drifting. Each one
# is run against these exact cases - Rust in `feedback::tests::email_rule_matches_shared_table`,
# the other two by `scripts/check-email-rule.ps1`.
#
# Format: <1|0>|<value>, where 1 = must be accepted. Everything after the FIRST '|' is the
# value verbatim, so a case may contain '|'. Blank lines and #-comments are ignored; a case
# whose value is empty is written as the bare prefix, and is covered by the length floor.
#
# The `0` cases are not hypothetical - prose, "n/a" and bare handles are the shapes that were
# actually arriving in the contact column before the field was made email-only (2026-08-05).
1|a@b.co
1|me@example.com
1|first.last@sub.domain.co.uk
1|x+tag@gmail.com
1|user_name-1@ex-ample.io
1|Me@Example.COM
1|user@example.museum
1|a.b.c@d.ef
0|
0|very slow thumbnails generation
0|n/a
0|nope
0|me@localhost
0|me@1
0|@example.com
0|me@
0|a@b.c
0|me@@example.com
0|me@example..com
0|me@.example.com
0|me@example.com.
0|me@-example.com
0|me@example.com-
0|me there@x.com
0|me@example.c0m
0|me@exam ple.com
0|discord: someguy#1234
0|https://example.com
0|+1 555 0100
0|me@example.com extra
